title.big: Offshore-wind monopile CP, answered in chat
title.desc: Ask in plain English. Deckhand asks for what it needs, runs the calculation, and sends back a report you can keep.

turns.html: Need a sacrificial-anode CP design for an offshore-wind monopile, 30-year life. Can you run DNV-RP-B401?

Happy to — a few details so I run it right:
  • Exposure zones and areas — submerged, splash, atmospheric?
  • Coating category in each zone?
  • Design life, and the seawater temperature & resistivity?
  • Anode type and unit mass?
This runs the DNV-RP-B401 zone-by-zone screen — current demand per zone, anode mass, then a current-output check on the count.

Monopile — 1,200 m² submerged, 180 m² splash, 120 m² atmospheric, all coating cat I. 30-year design life. North Sea at 8 °C, resistivity 0.28 Ω·m. Aluminium stand-off anodes, 150 kg each, utilisation 0.85. Make-up's in the file.

Got it — three zones over a 30-year life, so I'll run DNV-RP-B401 zone by zone. Basis I'll use: current demand per zone from area × density × coating breakdown, total charge over 30 yr → anode mass, then a current-output check that the bank delivers the final demand. Running it now…

Here's the design — and it flags the governing criterion:
QuantityResultCheckVerdict
Mean current demand27.7 Afinal 51.5 A—
Required anode mass4,285 kg——
Anodes by mass (150 kg)29——
Anodes by current output32governs✅ Use 32
30-year life on a North Sea monopile. Mass alone needs 29 stand-off anodes, but the 51.5 A final demand needs 32 by current output — so 32 governs. The thin coating breakdown over 30 years is what drives the final current up.

report.title: Monopile CP Design (DNV-RP-B401)
report.inputs:
Structure — exposure zones
Submerged 1,200 m² · splash 180 m² · atmospheric 120 m² — all coating cat I

Design & environment
Design life 30 yr · North Sea 8 °C · resistivity 0.28 Ω·m

Anodes
Al stand-off · 150 kg each · utilisation 0.85
capacity 2,000 Ah/kg · resistance 0.153 Ω
report.methodology:
1 · Current demand per zone = area × density × coating breakdown (cat I: initial 0.05 / mean 0.35 / final 0.65).
2 · Total charge over 30 yr (262,800 h) → anode mass (capacity 2,000 Ah/kg, utilisation 0.85).
3 · Anode count by mass, then by current output (through the anode resistance at final demand).
4 · The larger count governs.
report.outputs:
QuantityValueNote
Total area1,500 m²3 zones
Demand — submerged21.0 / 39.0 Amean / final
Demand — splash6.3 / 11.7 Amean / final
Demand — atmospheric0.42 / 0.78 Amean / final
Total current demand27.72 / 51.48 Amean / final
Required anode mass4,285.19 kg29 × 150 kg
Anodes by current output321.63 A each
Verdict: USE 32 ANODES — mass needs 29, but the current-output check (final demand 51.5 A vs 47.3 A from 29 anodes) governs at 32.
